answer: Pay for verified work, never for headcount. Cut each epoch's job into small tiles, like pages of an atlas, and let any ID pull batches of 40 from one shared queue, each batch its own island of work. Roughly 1 tile in 10 is a hidden anchor with a known answer; miss two anchors and the whole batch pays nothing. There's no per-ID base reward, only a share of the pool per accepted tile, so 100 clones on one GPU clear the same tiles that GPU would alone and earn the same, while each sloppy clone risks voiding its batches. Batch size and anchor rate are my picks.
